forum.content_text:
Hi,

In STM32CubeIDE/MX versions 1.19 and 6.15, I configured HRTIM, and it worked fine without any errors in CubeMX. I have updated STM32CubeIDE/MX to versions 2.1.1 and 6.16.1, and I have noticed the error messages shown in the pictures below.

The dead time is not used, but when set Output 2 state MX displays the message "**Set Sources: nothing to set as Dead Time is enabled, Output2 signal is defined based on Output1 Configuration Set Sources".**The project operates like before the update, but it is not possible to add new Set Sources (I can only change the number of Set Sources to zero).

How to understand this behaviour?

Krzysztof

![Pic1.jpg](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/9841565a-2108-0166-6eca-66ba1b7194a4.jpg "Pic1.jpg")![Pic2.jpg](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/1c561c69-1b25-5561-b44b-aa1d862a3dbb.jpg "Pic2.jpg")
